summaryForNext: READ THIS FIRST - POST-ASSESS OPERATOR DECISIONS CHANGED THE BASELINE (assessment.md ADDENDUM; goals.md REVISED): the Karpathy/OKF knowledge layer uses the Rust pk CLI, vendored at tools/prometheus-knowledge (01a1dbe, pk 1.8.0) - NOT a Node implementation. So the Node events.jsonl writer, log.md projection, OKF v0.2 writer and v0.1 reader are WITHDRAWN. BUT pk does not build for Windows today (pk-cli/src/main.rs:1216 unguarded std::os::unix; no CI; 0 releases) and pk has NO progress recorder - receipts/idempotency/replay live in the Python record-progress.py that CALLS pk ingest, so the recorder half is still open and the float-hash finding still applies to it. Changes to the pk repository need the operator go-ahead before pushing. Also decided: The Boss runs this pack under its bundled bun (tested on macOS arm64 only, all six hooks OK); both filesystem MCP servers ship; the-boss-integration is the NEXT phase. Review judge: liter-llm key supplied, MiniMax-M3 and k3 verified live; MiniMax-M3 emits a <think> block that a JSON parser must strip. The addendum itself is UNREVIEWED. ORIGINAL SUMMARY FOLLOWS. NOTHING IS BUILT: lib/karpathy, lib/okf, lib/memory all absent; all nine delivery goals NOT MET. Baseline 220 tests / 219 pass / 0 fail; 9 capabilities; specs 9/9. THE FINDING THAT CHANGES THE DESIGN: receipt hashes are NOT portable between the Python recorder and a naive Node port. The golden receipt carries "elapsedHours": 0.0; Python json.dumps writes 0.0, JSON.stringify writes 0, and after JSON.parse the distinction is gone. Node's sorted-key hash differs from the recorded eventSha256; re-emitting Python's float token reproduces it exactly. eventIdentitySha256 and the receipt filename DO match (no float in either). Upstream compares eventSha256 on replay to tell a duplicate from a collision, so README 5.3's 'a project can move between packs' fails today. ONE receipt, one observed case - analyze must decide: forbid non-integers in hashed fields, emit Python-compatible tokens, or declare the receipts incompatible. TWO EVENT SCHEMAS ALREADY SHARE events.jsonl: the 2 events there are pk's compile log (id, kind, session_id...), not progress events (schemaVersion, eventId, boundary...). One file or two is undecided, and another tool appends to it. APPEND IS NOT IN lib/platform: atomic-write replaces a file; an append-only log needs a different primitive, and lib/refiner/session.mjs appends by read-modify-write, which is wrong for an unbounded log. OKF bundle is PARTIAL: index.md says okf_version 0.2, but decisions.md and gotchas.md are single append-only files, not one concept per file - and CLAUDE.md section 0 tells every agent to read them at bootstrap, so migrating them changes the rules source in the same change. The v0.1 migration path is live in this repo (pk wrote a timestamp: field today). The 'exactly six ported ids' scenario in hooks/dispatch FAILS the moment a seventh hook is added - a spec amendment, not a surprise. PART 2 - THE BOSS INTEGRATION (operator-added scope, NOT a goal of this phase): 7 gaps across 3 repositories. The embedding mechanism exists: scripts/download-binaries.js (pinned version + sha256 per platform key) feeding resources/binaries, mirrored by BUNDLED_TOOLS (mise, bun, uv, rg) - compass and rust-mcp-filesystem would be two new entries, which presupposes PUBLISHED release artifacts. A missing platform key is skipped SILENTLY (if (!pkg) continue), and rust-mcp-filesystem has no aarch64-pc-windows-msvc build while The Boss ships win arm64. The natural install unit for the pack is an SDK LOCAL PLUGIN - builtin agents already ship a .claude/ plugin directory - which would answer three gaps at once (skills not self-contained; hooks.json not consumed; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT undefined) but this pack is not laid out as a plugin, and whether SDK 0.3.220 loads a local plugin's hooks.json is UNVERIFIED. node@22 is available on demand through mise, not bundled. The Boss already has an in-process filesystem MCP server (1,865 lines) with overlapping tool names - replace/coexist is the operator's call. Plugins load with skipMcpDiscovery: true, so both MCP servers must go through The Boss's catalog. RECOMMENDATION: its own phase, the-boss-integration, after this one; stated counter-argument: the plugin layout moves scripts/ and lib/, so every phase that adds files first adds files that will move. REVIEW: gpt-5.5 via the openai-proxy fallback - cross_model_check VERIFIED-DISTINCT, the first in two phases. Round 1 BLOCK (2 CRITICAL, 7 WARNING, 1 SUGGESTION) -> round 2 BLOCK (1 CRITICAL, 3 WARNING). Cap reached; all four round-2 fixes are UNREVIEWED and carried verbatim in assessment.md. The round-2 CRITICAL was a self-contradiction I introduced while rewriting. The primary judge (liter-llm: MiniMax-M3 / k3) still returns 401 - LITER_LLM_API_KEY is unset, and I was correctly blocked from reading the launch agent's config to find it. PROCESS NOTE: corrective action 1 (verify the claim) caught 2 of 5 counts wrong before review - 13 imports not 12, 7 regex alternatives not 5, both written by eye. It did not catch the unverified claims the judge found, because I only re-checked numbers, not assertions. OPEN FOR THE OPERATOR: (a) Gap 5 replace/coexist; (b) bundle Node, rely on mise, or run under bun; (c) hook route - plugin vs SDK callbacks; (d) whether the-boss-integration runs next or is pulled forward.
